memberdef.name: fiberlib

simplesect.para: : sets table field specified by name of the table on top of the stack to a weak kv table and pops that weak table.

briefdescription.para: Push a userdata for the given fiber onto Lua stack.
Utility function for fiber.create and fiber.new.
Create, resume and detach a fiber given the function and its arguments.
Create a fiber, schedule it for execution, but not invoke yet.

detaileddescription.para: With no arguments, gets or sets the current fiber name. It's also possible to get/set the name of another fiber. Last argument can be a map with a single key: {truncate = boolean}. If truncate is true, then a new fiber name is truncated to a max possible fiber name length. If truncate is false (or was not specified), then too long new name raise error.

briefdescription.para: Trigger invoked when the fiber has stopped execution of its current request.

detaileddescription.para: Only purpose - delete storage.lua.ref keeping a reference of Lua fiber.storage object. Unlike Lua stack, Lua fiber storage may be created not only for fibers born from Lua land. For example, an IProto request may execute a Lua function, which can create the storage. Trigger guarantees, that even for non-Lua fibers the Lua storage is destroyed.

briefdescription.para: Yield to the sched fiber and sleep.

briefdescription.para: Running and suspended fibers can be cancelled.
Check if this current fiber has been cancelled and throw an exception if this is the case.
Alternative to fiber.sleep(infinite) which does not participate in an event loop at all until an explicit wakeup.

detaileddescription.para: This is less overhead. Useful for fibers sleeping most of the time.
